messages_body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — excited to get Zephyr live on Redwood Private. To keep momentum I attached a lightweight onboarding checklist and a proposed 4-week enablement cadence. High level: network prep and firewall/IP allowlist, private control plane config, partner sandbox for labs, and a certification session for Zephyr engineers.

Can you confirm (1) whether your security team needs our SOC2 artifacts up front, (2) who will own on your side for network approvals, and (3) two preferred dates for an initial partner lab run?

I've cc'd Laura (partner ops) to book the enablement slots. If helpful I can bcc Ben (partner enablement lead) for pricing/flex questions.

Attachments: zephyr-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference runtime
Hi Rafael and Laura,

Appreciate the follow-up. Quick answers: our security lead (Emily) will own SOC2 requests — I'll loop her here. Network approvals are managed by our cloud infra team; I can introduce them once you share the expected CIDR ranges and egress rules. For partner labs, the week of May 29 or June 5 are best for our engineers.

I'm attaching the network diagram we referenced on the call — it shows our VPC peering constraints. Could you review and call out any specific requirements?

Thanks,
Sam Park
Head of Partnerships | Zephyr Consulting
sam.park@zephyr-consulting.com
Attachments: private-deploy-network-drawings.png

On Tue, May 10, 2028 at 9:22 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call yesterday — excited to get Zephyr live on Redwood Private...
Sam — thanks for the quick reply and the diagram. Laura and I reviewed the VPC sketch: only a couple of asks. We'll need:

- Static egress IPs for the control plane (we'll provide a /29).
- TLS mutual auth between your bastion and our private control plane endpoint.
- 10.0.0.0/24 reserved for KV cache traffic in the partner sandbox (to avoid overlap).

I've attached a more detailed onboarding checklist that maps tasks to owners and a draft MOU section for scope & timelines. If May 29 works, we propose:

Week 0 (prep): exchange SOC2 artifacts, network allowlist, and k8s access (if on-prem).
Week 1: partner sandbox + labs (certification lab 1).
Week 2: performance tuning & quantization brief (lab 2).
Week 3: cutover runbook + shadow traffic.

Please have Emily pull the SOC2 checklist (I put the filename in the attachments). Laura — can you suggest two training slots for the certification lab?

Attachments: draft-multiparty-mou.docx, zephyr-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Best,
Rafael
Hi team — looping in the training plan and lab calendar. I propose two 90-minute lab sessions (Thursday May 30 and Wednesday June 5) run by Ben and the Partner Labs team. Each session covers: environment sanity checks, one end-to-end private deploy, and troubleshooting patterns for common infra pain points.

Certification path:
- Level 1: Successful end-to-end deploy in sandbox + runbook sign-off.
- Level 2: Performance tuning lab + guidance on batching/quantization.

I've attached partner-cert-labs-calendar.ics for you to accept and an outline deck I'll use with Zephyr engineers. Rafael — Ben will be on standby for pricing/flex if you need to accelerate capacity.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Partner Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: partner-cert-labs-calendar.ics
Rafael / Laura — thanks, that schedule works and Emily will start pulling SOC2 artifacts today. A couple of practical asks from our infra lead: can you share the control-plane CIDR and the public-facing IPs you mentioned? Also, we prefer the draft MOU to include a 30-day rollback clause for initial runs. I've attached our SOC2 intake sheet with the questions we've received so far.

Emily Zhou
Security Manager | Zephyr Consulting
emily.z@zephyr-consulting.com
Attachments: soc2-evidence-requests.xlsx
Emily / Sam / team — got the SOC2 sheet, thank you. Control plane egress IPs: 34.210.11.8/29 and 34.210.11.16/29 (we'll provide the exact list in the onboarding doc). We can add the 30-day rollback clause to the MOU draft — see the attached updated doc.

Next steps I will action today:
1) Upload SOC2 artifacts to the shared drive link and ping Emily.
2) Finalize the lab invites (May 30 & June 5) — calendar invites sent.
3) Share the control-plane allowlist and the short cutover runbook.

Ben — bcc'd for pricing/credits if Zephyr needs a short pilot discount for the sandbox runs.

Thanks all — looking forward to the labs.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft-multiparty-mou.docx, zephyr-onboarding-checklist.pdf
